triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_activity_assignment_immutables()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.activity_id       IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.activity_id       OR
     NEW.student_id        IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.student_id        OR
     NEW.title             IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.title             OR
     NEW.subtitle          IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.subtitle          OR
     NEW.instructions      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.instructions      OR
     NEW.item_format       IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.item_format       OR
     NEW.items             IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.items             OR
     NEW.assigned_by       IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.assigned_by       OR
     NEW.class_id          IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.class_id          OR
     NEW.mode              IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.mode              OR
     NEW.source_section    IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source_section    OR
     NEW.time_goal_minutes IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.time_goal_minutes OR
     NEW.created_at        IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'activity_assignments: snapshot columns are immutable for non-admin users';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_classroom_items_student_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') then
    return new;
  end if;

  if new.id                 is distinct from old.id
     or new.student_id      is distinct from old.student_id
     or new.class_id        is distinct from old.class_id
     or new.created_by      is distinct from old.created_by
     or new.type            is distinct from old.type
     or new.title           is distinct from old.title
     or new.description     is distinct from old.description
     or new.content_html    is distinct from old.content_html
     or new.content_markdown is distinct from old.content_markdown
     or new.source_table    is distinct from old.source_table
     or new.source_id       is distinct from old.source_id
     or new.unlock_at       is distinct from old.unlock_at
     or new.due_at          is distinct from old.due_at
     or new.priority        is distinct from old.priority
     or new.visible_to_student is distinct from old.visible_to_student
     or new.created_at      is distinct from old.created_at
  then
    raise exception 'classroom_items: students may only update status, completed_at and metadata_json on their own items'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$
